Classifying the scene's ambient soundscape into a single fixed enum tag.

The scene is an outdoor fantasy ritual with a formal assembly and murmuring. I am weighing the available tags to find the best fit.

The crowd_outdoor tag is modern and unsuitable. medieval_village fits the pre-industrial fantasy setting.

medieval_village is the best fit. The clearing and spiralgrass suggest a ritual site rather than a village, but the tag covers pre-industrial fantasy settlements.

The prior tag is neutral_quiet, an indoor room. The new scene is an outdoor clearing with an assembly. This location change means the prior tag should be kept. No suitable replacement exists in the enum.

A new candidate emerged: court_intrigue. The formal inquiry, Dohkar and Chayr roles, and the tarot deck all suggest a tense pre-industrial court scene.
